title: Taal - Non Stop Garba
label: Geeta Rabari Official
notes: Amazon Music publishes the full 21-track September 12, 2022 edition and exposes a distinct track href for every item. Tracks 1-3 are long nonstop masters named Taal (1), Taal (2) and Taal (3); they are tracks within this release, not separate album volumes. Qobuz independently confirms the 21-track order and reports a 2:26:09 total, while the rounded Amazon track displays sum to 2:26:21. Canonical durations retain Amazon's displayed values and document the 12-second aggregate provider-rounding variance. Geeta Rabari's official YouTube distribution independently confirms the three long master tracks.
